items.title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Faces Mortgage Bond Return Risk From AI Refinancing
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) and other mortgage bond investors are assessing how the rapid use of AI in mortgage refinancing could affect income from mortgage-backed securities. Mortgage lenders are using AI tools to speed up refinancing decisions, which can change repayment timelines for home loans that back these securities.
